data_fields.name: buff_drop_remaining_time
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: a dropped buff expires at death time plus the time it had left

best_idea: On death a buff drop keeps the time it had left and expires with it, and the victim's ammo goes into one timed backpack clamped to per-type caps on pickup.
decision_why: Take the timed drops and the remaining-time carry; move the ammo into the backpack instead of copying it, because the donor copies it and our ledger must hold one count.
acceptance: A player who dies with 20 s of ring left leaves a ring pickup showing 20 s that removes itself at 0 s; a player who dies with ammo leaves one backpack holding that ammo, removed after 120 s; a server test asserts the victim's ammo is zero after death and a pickup clamps shells at 100.
